name: Lucky Dragon Hibachi
facts: Lucky Dragon Hibachi is in Compton, California.
Hours: Mon–Thu 11:00a–9:00p, Fri–Sat 11:00a–10:00p, Sun 12:00p–8:00p.
Hibachi Catch is a free 30-second game. No account is needed to play.
You slide the tray with your finger to catch hibachi food.
Each food catch is +10, a gold star is +50, and flames, candy and ice are −20.
Dragon fire is −30. Three dragon hits burn your food and end the run.
Catching in a row builds a streak bonus of +2 per catch, up to +10 extra.
650+ points in one run puts you on the weekly board (sample prize: 15% off your next meal).
Weekly board: 1st place wins 50% off your next meal and 2nd place wins 20% off (sample prizes).
The weekly board runs Monday through Sunday close and resets every Monday.
Daily Spin: free, one spin per member per day (Los Angeles time), and every slice wins something.
Spin food prizes and discounts are good for 3 days at the Compton location, one reward per visit.
Reward ladder: 250 pts Free extra Yum-Yum, 500 pts Free fried rice, 800 pts Free hibachi plate, 1300 pts Dinner for two.
New member offer: Free Extra Yum-Yum + 10% off your next plate.
Refer a friend and the referral gift is a Free fried rice.
An account needs a name, phone number and email. One account per person and per phone.
You must be 13 or older. Under 18 needs a parent's or guardian's permission.
No purchase is needed to play, spin or win, and buying food does not improve your chances.
No prize includes alcohol.
Language menu (🌐 button) includes English, Spanish, Chinese, Korean, Tagalog, Vietnamese, Armenian, Persian, Japanese, Thai and Russian.
Instagram: @luckydragon360.
Your info is used only for your rewards account and is never sold.

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: Mon–Thu 11:00a–9:00p, Fri–Sat 11:00a–10:00p, and Sun 12:00p–8:00p.

qa.q: Are you open on Sunday?
qa.a: Yes, Sundays we're open 12:00p–8:00p.

qa.q: Are you open on Friday and Saturday night?
qa.a: Yes. Fri and Sat we're open 11:00a–10:00p.

qa.q: What time do you close on weekdays?
qa.a: Monday through Thursday we close at 9:00p.

qa.q: What time do you open?
qa.a: Mon–Sat we open at 11:00a, and Sunday at 12:00p.

qa.q: Are you open on holidays?
qa.a: I don't have holiday hours. Please call 562-564-9200 to check.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: We're in Compton, California. The exact street address isn't listed in the app yet. Tap Directions to open Google Maps, or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: What's your address?
qa.a: The app says Compton, CA but doesn't show the street address yet. Tap the Directions button to open Google Maps, or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: How do I get directions?
qa.a: Tap the Directions button in the app and it opens Google Maps to Lucky Dragon Hibachi in Compton.

qa.q: Is there parking?
qa.a: I don't have parking details. Please call 562-564-9200 and ask the staff.

qa.q: What's your phone number?
qa.a: Call us at 562-564-9200. You can also tap Call to order in the app.

qa.q: How do I call to order?
qa.a: Tap the Call to order button in the app, or dial 562-564-9200.

qa.q: Do you take reservations?
qa.a: I don't have reservation info. Please call 562-564-9200 to ask.

qa.q: Do you deliver?
qa.a: I don't have delivery details. Please call 562-564-9200 and ask the staff.

qa.q: Can I order for pickup or takeout?
qa.a: You can call 562-564-9200 to order. I don't have other pickup details, so ask the staff.

qa.q: Can I order from my table or by QR code?
qa.a: I don't have table-ordering or QR details. Ask your server or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: Can I build my own plate in the app?
qa.a: Yes, there's a Build your plate section. Pick a base, add proteins and extras, then place your order.

qa.q: What bases can I pick when building a plate?
qa.a: Fried rice, chow mein, or half & half.

qa.q: What proteins can I add to my plate?
qa.a: Chicken, steak, shrimp, salmon and scallops. You can add up to 2 each of chicken, steak and shrimp, and 1 each of salmon and scallops.

qa.q: What extras can I add?
qa.a: Hibachi veggies and Yum-Yum sauce. You can add up to 2 Yum-Yum.

qa.q: What's on the menu?
qa.a: Hibachi Chicken, Hibachi Steak, Hibachi Shrimp, the Chicken + Shrimp Combo and Premium Lobster. Sides are Fried Rice, Noodles and Extra Yum-Yum.

qa.q: What is the Hibachi Chicken?
qa.a: Grilled chicken with fried rice, veggies and house yum-yum sauce.

qa.q: What comes with the Hibachi Steak?
qa.a: Sirloin with fried rice, veggies and double yum-yum.

qa.q: What comes with the Hibachi Shrimp?
qa.a: Jumbo shrimp with fried rice and veggies.

qa.q: What is the Chicken + Shrimp Combo?
qa.a: It's a combo of hibachi chicken and shrimp, and it's on our menu. Ask staff for what comes with it.

qa.q: Do you have lobster?
qa.a: Yes, Premium Lobster, grilled hibachi style. You can add it to any meal. It's market price (MP), so ask staff for today's price.

qa.q: What sides do you have?
qa.a: Fried Rice (wok-fired with egg and scallion), garlic butter hibachi Noodles, and Extra Yum-Yum.

qa.q: What's Yum-Yum sauce?
qa.a: It's our house sauce. Hibachi plates come with it, and you can add Extra Yum-Yum anytime.

qa.q: How much do things cost?
qa.a: The prices in the app are samples, so I can't confirm them. Please call 562-564-9200 for current prices. Lobster is market price.

qa.q: Do you have vegetarian options?
qa.a: The app lists hibachi veggies, fried rice and noodles. I don't have details on ingredients, so please ask staff.

qa.q: Do you have allergen information?
qa.a: I don't have allergen details. Please tell staff about any allergy or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: Do you serve drinks?
qa.a: Drinks appear in our game, but I don't have a drink menu. Please ask staff what's available.

qa.q: What is the game?
qa.a: It's Hibachi Catch, a 30-second game. Slide the tray to catch hibachi food and dodge the dragon's fire.

qa.q: How do I play Hibachi Catch?
qa.a: Tap to start, then slide your finger across the game to move the tray. Catch the food and dodge flames, candy, ice and the dragon's fire. You have 30 seconds.

qa.q: What are the controls?
qa.a: Just slide your finger left and right to move the tray. On a computer, move the mouse. With a game controller, use the stick or D-pad.

qa.q: How long is a game?
qa.a: 30 seconds, unless the dragon burns your food first.

qa.q: Is the game free?
qa.a: Yes. Hibachi Catch is free to play and you don't need to buy anything.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play?
qa.a: No. Anyone can play for free as often as they like. You only need a free member account to save your score or claim a prize.

qa.q: How often can I play?
qa.a: As often as you like. The game is free with no limit.

qa.q: What food do I catch?
qa.a: Chicken, steak, shrimp, lobster, veggies, chow mein, fried rice and drinks. Each is worth +10.

qa.q: How many points is each catch worth?
qa.a: Each food or drink is +10. A gold star is +50.

qa.q: What is the gold star?
qa.a: A rare star worth +50. It also keeps your streak going.

qa.q: What is the streak bonus?
qa.a: Catch in a row without a miss and you earn +2 extra per catch, up to +10 extra. At 5 or more in a row, that's +20 a catch.

qa.q: What should I dodge?
qa.a: Flames, candy and ice cost −20 each and reset your streak. Dragon fire costs −30.

qa.q: How does the dragon work?
qa.a: The dragon flies across the top, locks onto your tray with a dashed red line, then breathes fire. Move out of the way!

qa.q: What happens if the dragon hits me?
qa.a: You lose 30 points and your streak resets. The rice gets darker with each hit.

qa.q: When does the game end early?
qa.a: After three dragon hits your food is burnt and the run is over.

qa.q: What is the paper lantern?
qa.a: Once per run, a paper lantern floats down about 12–20 seconds in. Catch it on your tray for +300 bonus points and a link to Antidote The Foodie's review.

qa.q: What is halftime?
qa.a: After about 85–95 seconds of total play, your next run opens with a short break showing Antidote The Foodie's review of Lucky Dragon. You can skip it or watch the full review.

qa.q: What score do I need to make the weekly board?
qa.a: 650 points or more in one run puts you on the weekly board.

qa.q: How does the weekly leaderboard work?
qa.a: The highest score from Monday through Sunday close wins. Ties go to the score posted first, and the board resets every Monday.

qa.q: What do I win on the weekly board?
qa.a: Sample prizes: 1st place gets 50% off your next meal and 2nd place gets 20% off. A run of 650+ earns 15% off your next meal. Ask staff to confirm the current prizes.

qa.q: When does the weekly board reset?
qa.a: Every Monday. New winners every week.

qa.q: Who wins the weekly prize?
qa.a: The player with the highest score from Monday through Sunday close. Second place also gets a prize.

qa.q: What if two people tie?
qa.a: The tie goes to whoever posted the score first.

qa.q: Is the game luck or skill?
qa.a: Skill. Hibachi Catch prizes depend only on your score and your rank on the weekly board, not on chance.

qa.q: Do I have to buy something to win?
qa.a: No. No purchase or payment is needed to play, spin or win, and buying food doesn't improve your chances.

qa.q: How do I save my score?
qa.a: After a run, join with a free member account (name, phone number and email). Your score then goes on the board.

qa.q: How do I claim a prize?
qa.a: Sign in to your member account after your run. If you win, you may be asked to show the code on your phone and your matching account at the counter.

qa.q: Can cheating get me disqualified?
qa.a: Yes. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts are disqualified.

qa.q: Can employees win prizes?
qa.a: Employees and their household members may play but can't win prizes.

qa.q: Who can play for prizes?
qa.a: U.S. legal residents age 13 or older. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission. Void where prohibited.

qa.q: Is there a kids mode?
qa.a: There's no separate kids mode. Players under 18 need a parent's or guardian's permission to have an account.

qa.q: What is the Daily Spin?
qa.a: A free spin of the prize wheel. Every slice wins something, from bonus points to discounts and free food.

qa.q: How often can I spin?
qa.a: Once per member per day, based on Los Angeles time. It's always free, and spins can't be bought.

qa.q: What can I win on the Daily Spin?
qa.a: +50, +100 or +75 reward points, $2 off a hibachi plate, free extra Yum-Yum, a free side of fried rice, or 10% off your order.

qa.q: What are the odds on the spin?
qa.a: +50 pts 30%, +100 pts 20%, +75 pts 15%, $2 off a plate 15%, free Yum-Yum 8%, free fried rice 7%, and 10% off your order 5%.

qa.q: How long do spin prizes last?
qa.a: Food prizes and discounts are good for 3 days at the Lucky Dragon Compton location. One reward per visit, and they can't be combined with other rewards.

qa.q: Can I trade my spin prize for cash?
qa.a: No. Prizes have no cash value and can't be transferred.

qa.q: Do you give alcohol as a prize?
qa.a: No. No prize includes alcohol.

qa.q: How do I join the rewards program?
qa.a: Sign up for a free member account with your name, phone number and email. The live app confirms your phone number with a text code.

qa.q: What do I need to sign up?
qa.a: A name, a phone number and an email address.

qa.q: Can I have more than one account?
qa.a: No. It's one free account per person and per phone. Your account is tied to the phone it was made on.

qa.q: What do I get for joining?
qa.a: The welcome offer is a Free Extra Yum-Yum and 10% off your next plate.

qa.q: How do reward points work?
qa.a: Points from the Daily Spin and from purchases go into your Lucky Dragon Hibachi Rewards account. You can trade them for the rewards listed in the app. Points have no cash value.

qa.q: How many points do I get per dollar?
qa.a: I don't have the points-per-dollar rate. Ask staff or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: How many points do I get per visit?
qa.a: I don't have a per-visit point amount. Ask staff or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: Do I earn points for playing the game?
qa.a: The app doesn't list points for game scores. Games give you a weekly-board score and possible prizes. Daily Spin wins can add reward points.

qa.q: What rewards can I get?
qa.a: At 250 pts: Free extra Yum-Yum. At 500 pts: Free fried rice. At 800 pts: Free hibachi plate. At 1300 pts: Dinner for two.

qa.q: How many points for a free hibachi plate?
qa.a: 800 points.

qa.q: How many points for free fried rice?
qa.a: 500 points.

qa.q: How many points for free Yum-Yum?
qa.a: 250 points gets you a free extra Yum-Yum.

qa.q: How many points for dinner for two?
qa.a: 1300 points.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Open the rewards card in the app, pick a reward you have enough points for, and show the code on your phone at the counter.

qa.q: What are the levels or tiers?
qa.a: The app doesn't list member levels for Lucky Dragon. The rewards ladder goes from 250 to 1300 points. Ask staff for more.

qa.q: Is there a birthday reward?
qa.a: I don't have birthday club details. Ask staff or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: Can I refer a friend?
qa.a: Yes. The referral gift is a Free fried rice. Ask staff how it works.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for being nearby?
qa.a: If you're close, the app can show a heads-up. When you show the nearby offer at the counter, you get double stars on that day's order.

qa.q: Do you have daily specials or happy hour?
qa.a: I don't have happy hour or daily specials listed. We do have seasonal holiday specials in the app. Call 562-564-9200 for anything else.

qa.q: What holiday specials do you have?
qa.a: The app lists specials for Halloween, Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Year, Valentine's, St. Patrick's, Cinco de Mayo and July 4th. They're sample deals, so ask staff to confirm.

qa.q: What is the Halloween special?
qa.a: Dragon Fire Night (Oct 20–31): Hibachi Steak with Extra Yum-Yum, code BOO. Ask staff to confirm the deal.

qa.q: What is the Thanksgiving special?
qa.a: Family Hibachi Feast (Nov 20–28): Chicken + Shrimp Combo with Fried Rice (solo) and Noodles for the table.

qa.q: What is the Christmas special?
qa.a: Holiday Lobster Hibachi (Dec 15–25): Premium Lobster on the hibachi (market price) with Fried Rice.

qa.q: What is the New Year special?
qa.a: Long-Life Noodles (Dec 29–Jan 1): Hibachi Chicken + Noodles, for a long, lucky year.

qa.q: What is the Valentine's special?
qa.a: Hibachi for Two (Feb 7–14): Hibachi Steak + Hibachi Shrimp to share, with extra Yum-Yum on the side.

qa.q: What are the other holiday specials?
qa.a: Lucky Dragon Day (Mar 14–17): Hibachi Chicken with Extra Yum-Yum. Cinco Hibachi Shrimp (May 1–5): Hibachi Shrimp + Fried Rice. Fourth of July Grill (Jul 1–4): Chicken + Shrimp Combo + Noodles.

qa.q: Is there trivia or a sports feature?
qa.a: Not in this app. We have the Hibachi Catch game, the Daily Spin and the weekly board.

qa.q: Can I use the app in another language?
qa.a: Yes. Tap the 🌐 button at the top right and pick a language. Options include Spanish, Chinese, Korean, Tagalog, Vietnamese, Armenian, Persian, Japanese, Thai and Russian.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my phone?
qa.a: On iPhone Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, then Add. On Android Chrome, tap Install app, or the ⋮ menu then Add to Home screen.

qa.q: Why can't I add it from Instagram or Facebook?
qa.a: Those in-app browsers can't add apps. Open the page in Safari or Chrome first, then add it to your Home Screen.

qa.q: Can I play with a game controller?
qa.a: Yes. Connect a Bluetooth or USB controller and press any button. The stick or D-pad slides the tray.

qa.q: How do I lock the screen so it won't scroll?
qa.a: Tap the lock button on the right side of the screen. Full screen is also available during play.

qa.q: Do you have an Instagram?
qa.a: Yes, @luckydragon360. The app also shows our latest posts and reels.

qa.q: Can I leave a Google review?
qa.a: Yes. The app has a button to write a Google review. Honest reviews only, and no points or prizes are given for reviews.

qa.q: Who is Antidote The Foodie?
qa.a: A food reviewer who reviewed Lucky Dragon Hibachi. You can find the lantern in the game and watch the review on YouTube.

qa.q: Will I get texts from you?
qa.a: Reward texts go with your account. Deal and marketing texts are optional, and you can stop them anytime by replying STOP.

qa.q: Is my information safe?
qa.a: Your information is used only for your rewards account and is never sold. Your location stays on your phone.

qa.q: Can I get help from a person?
qa.a: Yes. Ask any staff member, or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: What if I have a problem with my prize or points?
qa.a: Show the staff your account and prize code at the counter, or call 562-564-9200.

qa.q: Can the rules change?
qa.a: Yes. The restaurant may change or end the game, spin, prizes or rules at any time, with notice in the app. The official rules in the app are currently a draft.

qa.q: Are the game tokens a thing?
qa.a: Not right now. Hibachi Catch is free with no tokens.

qa.q: Do I have to pay taxes on a prize?
qa.a: Any taxes on a prize are the winner's responsibility.
